simple.meaning: חָזוֹת (châzôwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a revelation.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חָזוֹת (H2378) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חָזוֹת (châzôwth) / H2378 is traced through 2 Chronicles 9:29 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
